subject: SRE backfill + proposed band recalibration (internal transfer candidate)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SRE backfill + proposed band recalibration (internal transfer candidate)

Hi Monica / Laura,

Quick heads-up — Sanjay in SRE resigned effective Dec 3. He was an SRE II focused on infra reliability (oncall rotation + core deployment automation). After reviewing the oncall load and upcoming Q1 initiatives (multi-region rollout + runtime optimizer), I want to request:

- A backfill for Sanjay's seat as an SRE (headcount retained).
- Recalibration of the role from SRE II to SRE Lead (regrade) to reflect expected ownership (oncall lead, cross-team runbooks, mentoring, and owning rollout SLOs).
- Band guidance: targeting band range 140–170k base (total target compensation ~200–230k with eq/bonus) given the market comp we saw for lead-level infra roles.

Rationale: this is not just a 1:1 plug — the scope will include being the primary oncall lead for infra, leading the reliability cadence for two services, and a heavier mentoring responsibility for two junior SREs. I attached a draft JD and a short market comp analysis.

There is an internal candidate I want to consider for the slot: Rohan Mehta (cc'd). He's been on the infra rotations for 9 months and has stepped up on multiple postmortems; he is interested in the role but will need a band uplift to match the Lead responsibilities. If we approve regrade + internal transfer, this is the fastest path and keeps institutional knowledge. If not possible, I will open an external search (slower / higher comp).

Budget note: I propose filling within our existing headcount for Q4; if we need to hit cost neutrality we can delay one open IC hire in infra (ticket HR-7891) — happy to work with Finance.

Asks:
- Approval to regrade this backfill to SRE Lead (SRE III equivalent)
- Agreement on proposed band guidance or ask People Ops for alternative band if needed
- If approved, allow an internal transfer process with an expedited interview loop (1 week)

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20261126-sre-lead-proposal-jd.docx; 20261126-market-comp-analysis.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SRE backfill + proposed band recalibration (internal transfer candidate)

Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick context. A few clarifying Qs before I take this to Compensation: 

1) Can you share a short bullet list of the specific additional responsibilities vs the prior SRE II (e.g., number of services owned, oncall escalation duties, mentoring FTEs)?
2) Confirm the target on-base % increase vs Sanjay's current base and whether we need immediate eq/bonus uplift in the offer?
3) If Rohan is the intended internal candidate, do we need an exception to do a level-up via transfer or run a full loop (we typically require 2 interviews + calibration)?
4) Please confirm preferred start window (we'll aim for <30 days if internal).

I reviewed the attached comp analysis at a glance — it looks reasonable but I'll need a formal comp packet (range + midpoint + comp rationale) to route to Compensation governance. Also looping in Laura since this impacts the infra budget and any headcount reprioritization.

If you can reply with the bullet answers I can move this to Comp and Finance.

—Monica
Monica Patel
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 10:03 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick context. A few clarifying Qs before I take this to Compensation: 
> 
> 1) Can you share a short bullet list of the specific additional responsibilities vs the prior SRE II (e.g., number of services owned, oncall escalation duties, mentoring FTEs)?
> 2) Confirm the target on-base % increase vs Sanjay's current base and whether we need immediate eq/bonus uplift in the offer?
> 3) If Rohan is the intended internal candidate, do we need an exception to do a level-up via transfer or run a full loop (we typically require 2 interviews + calibration)?
> 4) Please confirm preferred start window (we'll aim for <30 days if internal).

Answers below and short appendix attached (rohan_internal-transfer-note):

1) Responsibilities delta (summary):
- Primary oncall lead for infra (ownership of oncall rota, runbook escalation matrix).
- Lead reliability cadence for two production services (throughput 12k rps combined).
- Mentor + career mentor two junior SREs (regular 1:1s and runbook docs).
- Point owner for the Q1 multi-region rollout SLO tuning.

2) Sanjay's current base: $120,000. Proposed base for SRE Lead: $150,000–165,000 (midpoint $157,500) — ~31% midpoint uplift. We recommend immediate base uplift for internal transfer to align with responsibilities; eq/bonus can be calibrated to midpoint targets.

3) Rohan: he has operational experience on our infra rotations and has led 2 postmortems. He will accept an internal transfer with a level-up if we can sign him at the proposed band. Process-wise: we request an expedited internal loop (skip external panel) — 2 hiring manager touchpoints + comp calibration should be sufficient. Monica, is that acceptable?

4) Start window: target Dec 6 if internal. If external, earliest realistic start is Jan 15.

Attachments: 20261127-rohan_internal-transfer-note.pdf

Let me know if you need anything else; happy to hop on a 15 min sync.

—Camila
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SRE backfill + proposed band recalibration (internal transfer candidate)

Thanks for the clear ask and the comp packet. I approve the regrade to SRE Lead and the proposed band guidance (150k–165k base) for this role conditional on two items:

1) Cost-neutral plan: Camila — please work with Finance (cc'd) to hedge by delaying one non-urgent infra IC hire (HR-7891) or moving funds from the infra contractor line. The expectation is we do not exceed the current infra headcount budget for Q4.
2) Internal-first: prioritize Rohan with an expedited loop (2 interviews + comp calibration). If Rohan declines or the transfer fails, you can proceed to open an external search within the approved band.

Monica — please route the comp packet to Compensation governance and let me know when Finance signs off on the cost-neutral plan. Laura — FYI given downstream budget implications.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
